setup: Line your knee up with the machine's pivot
Pad just above the back of the heel
Hips pressed into the pad or seat
Pick a lighter pin than for both legs
execution: Curl your heel toward your glutes
Squeeze for a moment at the end
Lower slowly to a straight knee
Keep your hips down the whole rep
faults: Don't lift your hips to finish the rep
Don't let the weight drop back
Don't twist to help the working leg

notes: Works on a lying or a seated leg curl. Use the same machine each time so your numbers compare.
Set the knee in line with the pivot and the pad above the heel, not on the calf.
The stack number is the selector reading and isn't half of a two-leg set.
If pain lingers or comes back, stop this exercise and get it checked by a physio or doctor.
stopIf: Pain that changes how you move
